newsitem.title: USA: Schlumberger, Baker Hughes in marketing pact.
newsitem.headline: Schlumberger, Baker Hughes in marketing pact.

text.p: Baker Hughes Inc said agreements have been reached with Schlumberger Ltd covering the joint development and marketing of the initial phase of Intelligent Completions Systems.

Intelligent Completions Systems integrate pressure, temperature and flow sensors with downhole flow control devices, enabling oil companies to remotely re-configure their well completions without the need for costly interventions or workovers.
This is one of the alliances outlined in the letter of intent announced by Schlumberger and Baker Hughes September 16, 1996. Since then product development has been progressing with a joint team.
Baker Hughes said the first integrated system is expected to be deployed later this year by Schlumberger's Wireline & Testing unit and Baker Oil Tools.
